book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: A JE' JU'UNA', RAJI' TI' U YET WINIQUIROB JUDÍO A CU TSICBAROB U T'ɅN HEBREO HEBREOS

content: Jesucristo jach manan no'j ti' u nunquir u winiquirob judío u c'aba' Moisés

In wet acsʌ'orirex a techexo' a mac a teta'b ten C'uj soc raji' yʌninechex C'uj. Raji' caj u t'ʌn techex quir u ts'ic techex a cuxtarex a cu tar ich ca'anan. Tucrex Jesús. Mʌ' ja wirej, raji' tuchi'ta'b ten C'uj quir u ts'ic to'onex a ba' cu ya'aric C'uj, bayiri' raji' u sacerdote a jach manan no'jo' ti' C'uj a mac a quij cariquex ij c'ujintiquex.

An ten bic Moisés caj u rʌc quibaj a ba' ara'b ten C'uj uch wa ber caj cuxa'an Moisés ich u rac'ob uch. Baxuc xan, ic Jaj Ts'urirex Jesucristo caj u rʌc quibaj tu cotor a ba' ara'b ten C'uj. Mʌ' ja wirej, quire' a Jesúso' caj ts'a'b u muc' ten C'uj.

Jach tsoy ca' ic sʌjtiquex ic nunquirex Moisés, chen jach manan ca' ic sʌjtex ic Jaj Ts'urirex Jesucristo. Mʌ' ja wirej, raji' irej a mac ic sʌjtiquex a cu c'ʌxic yatoch, mʌ' ic sʌjtiquex yatoch a c'ax ten mac.
Jujuntur yatoch c'ax ten xib. Bayiri' xan, tu cotor ba' a ti' yʌn ich yoc'ocab toc beta'b ten C'uj.

Jach taj a Moiséso' tu betaj u beyaj C'uj, caj u quibaj tu cotor ba' a ra' u q'uinino' ti' yʌn Moisés ich u yet winiquirob judío uch. Mʌ' ja wirej, u beyaj C'uj ti' Moisés quir u tsec'tic u t'ʌn C'uj ti' u yet winiquirob judío. A mun ts'a'b ten C'uj ti' Moisés ra' tu toc masaj ti' u yet winiquirob judío uch cax a cu bin tar ca' bin c'uchuc tu q'uinin.

Bayiri' xan, ic Jaj Ts'urirex Jesucristo caj u toc rʌc quibaj tu cotor a ba' ara'b ten C'uj. Chen ju muc'o' ts'a'b ti' ten C'uj jach manan ti' Jesús cax a Moiséso', quire' raji' Jesús u parar C'uj. Wa quij qui' quibiquex tu cotor a ba' ara'b ten C'uj ti' to'onex mix quic p'ʌtiquex u t'ʌn hasta u q'uinin ca' bin uruc quir u taquico'onex, je' u qui' acsico'onex quire' raji' yʌnino'onex C'uj.
Je' u tar yor mac a C'uj yʌnin

Mʌ' ja wirej, wa baxuco', jach manan tsoy ca' ij quibex u t'ʌn C'uj an ten bic caj ara'b ten u Taj'or u Pixam C'uj uch, tu cu ya'aric ti' a mac ts'a'b u tucur quir u tsicbar a ba' u c'at C'uj. U'yex ba' cu ya'aric C'uj:

content.text: Baje'rer wa ber ca wu'yiquex u t'ʌniquechex C'uj.
Mʌ' a chichquintiquex a jo'rex irechex a nunquirex caj u chichquintob u jo'rob uch. Mʌ' ja wirej, a nunquirex caj u chichquintob u jo'rob ich tʌcay ru'um uch, caj u p'ʌtob in t'ʌn, quij C'uj.
Mʌ' ja wirej, a nunquirex mʌ' tu yacsob tu yorob ti' ten, quij C'uj, cax tu yirob in carem beyaj ich tʌcay ru'um tu caj in pʌy u berob cuarenta yaxq'uin.

Rajen caj ts'iquijen, quij C'uj, yejer a nunquirex, a ra' cuxa'anob a ra' u q'uinino'. Rajen caj in wa'araj: Robob mʌ' c'ucha'an yorob u tucricob taj mʌ' biq'uin c'ucha'an yor u tucricob taj, robob mʌ' u quetquintic yorob yejer a ba' tin betaj.
Rajen caj ts'iquijen yejer a nunquirex caj in toc chich araj ti'ob mʌ' biq'uin quin bin in wacsic ti'ob ich u ru'umin a tin toc araj: Je' in ts'ic techexe'.

content: Rajen in wet acsʌ'orirex, qui' cʌnantex a bʌjex soc mʌ' a chichquintic a jo'rex soc mʌ' a p'ʌtiquex a wacsiquex ta worex ti' C'uj, a mac cʌja'an ich ca'anan, quij.

Rajen ca' ic pacran chich ariquex ti' ic bʌjobechex hasta ca' bin uruc ic Jaj Ts'urirex. Rajra' ca' ic pacran chich arex ti' ic bʌjobechex soc mʌ' ic tus pʌyiquex ic si'pirex soc mʌ' u chichtar ij jo'rex ten ic si'pirex.

Rajen ca' ic pacran chich ariquex ti' ic bʌjobechex. Quire' ca' bin uruc ic Jaj Ts'urirex Jesucristo je' ic pacran c'ʌmiquex a ba' raji' yʌnin, wa quij quibejex a ba' tu ya'araj to'onex, tan ij cacsiquex tij corex ti' an ten bic pʌyber caj ij yʌn acsex tij corex ti' caj ic yʌn quibex u t'ʌn uch.
Mʌ' ja wirej, ca' ij quibex a ba' cu chich aric to'onex, quire' tu toc araj uch, quij:

content.text: Jeroj ta wu'yajex in t'ʌn baje'rer, rajen mʌ' a chichquintic a jo'rex an ten bic a nunquirex uch tu chichquintajob u jo'rob ich tʌcay ru'um uch.

content: Mʌ' ja wirej, a mac a tu yubob u t'ʌn C'uj uch ich tʌcay ru'um. Ra'iri' u bʌjiri' tu p'ʌtob u t'ʌn C'uj. Robob, tu cotor u winiquirob judío a pa'y u berob ten Moisés caj joc'ob ich u ru'umin Egipto uch.
Mʌ' ja wirej, u winiquirob israel, a tu pʌyob u si'pirob, caj quimob ich tʌcay ru'um. Robob caj u ts'iquintob C'uj cuarenta yaxq'uin a ti' quimob ich tʌcay ru'um.

U winiquirob israel a mac mʌ' tu quibob u t'ʌn C'uj ich tʌcay ru'um uch caj ara'b ten C'uj ti'ob tan u chich ara' ten C'uj: “Jach taj, quij C'uj, mʌ' biq'uin quin bin in wacsiquechex tu ru'umin a tin toc araj: Je' in ts'ic techexe', quij.”
Rajen ij querex u winiquirob israel mʌ' c'ucha'an yorob u yocar tu ru'umin a tu ya'araj C'uj: Je' in ts'ic techex. Quire' mʌ' tu yacsob tu yorob ti'.
